messages:
Priya Raman: quick sync — proposing a narrow GA for inference-routing: ship with a 'partial SLA' for Tier A hosted customers, minimal docs, conservative telemetry. Need green from eng + commercial.
Sam Torres: agree in principle. define 'partial SLA' precisely: p99 server-side completion for non-streaming. streaming will have a p95 chunk-latency note.
Evan Wu: telemetry suggestion: full traces 0.5% sampling, latency histograms 5%. keeps cost down and gives signal for regressions.
Lena Park: docs must include Quickstart cURL + SDK, SLA copy, limitation list, and a small cost-estimate table. I'll write SLA copy and limitations.
Zoe Harper: commercial ask: sales wants a short, nonbinding contract blurb. Proposed wording: "Partial latency commitment for Tier A hosted; service credit framework TBD pending finance and legal." keeps us flexible.
legal-bot: Heads up — legal prefers no numeric credit language until finance signs off. Recommend "credits subject to contract" phrasing.
Priya Raman: Ops/oncall plan? who owns Tier A vs Tier B alerts?
Evan Wu: Tier A alerts -> infra rotation. Tier B noisy signals -> product rotation with debounce rules. I'll add escalation steps to the runbook.
Sam Torres: metric query to include in SLA doc (example):
```
percentile_over_time(99, latency_ms{route="/v1/generate",status="200"}, "1h")
```
Priya Raman: decision: proceed with the narrow GA as described unless we get a hard blocker in next 24h. Owners: Lena (SLA docs), Priya (quickstart), Sam (metric queries + examples), Evan (runbook + sampling knobs), Zoe (commercial blurb). Check-in tomorrow 10am PT.
Zoe Harper: I'll sync with finance and post any redlines here.
Evan Wu: I'll enable sampling in staging and drop the runbook paragraph by EOD.
Lena Park: Docs first draft by EOD tomorrow. Will call out streaming vs non-streaming measurement.
Priya Raman: cool — moving forward. Mark any hard blockers here and we'll re-evaluate. :thumbsup:
